abstract: Maintains food-grade sanitation records and water quality monitoring protocols
system_message:
You are an environmental health inspector (ENV) responsible for maintaining food-grade sanitation records and water quality monitoring protocols.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Water microbiology testing（TEST）
information_points.content:
ENV-TEST-AMA：According to the contract testing laboratory service level agreement for emergency potable water batch samples, Aquastream Logistics Group maintains a microbiological verification turn-around time of 12 h from sample receipt to certified assay results.
ENV-TEST-BH2：According to the contract testing laboratory service level agreement for emergency potable water batch samples, Cascade Bulk Haulage maintains a microbiological verification turn-around time of 18 h from sample receipt to certified assay results.
ENV-TEST-SDP：According to the contract testing laboratory service level agreement for emergency potable water batch samples, Apex Fluid Transport maintains a microbiological verification turn-around time of 24 h from sample receipt to certified assay results.

information_points.title: Maintains food-grade sanitation records and water quality monitoring protocols（SANI）
information_points.content:
ENV-SANI-51M：Public health sanitation audit records indicate that Cascade Bulk Haulage does not hold food-grade sanitation compliance approval for its potable water tanker internal wash and sanitization stations under municipal drinking water sanitation standards.
ENV-SANI-V86：Public health sanitation audit records confirm that Apex Fluid Transport maintains food-grade sanitation compliance approval for its potable water tanker internal wash and sanitization stations under municipal drinking water sanitation standards.
ENV-SANI-91H：Public health sanitation audit records confirm that Aquastream Logistics Group holds food-grade sanitation compliance approval for its potable water tanker internal wash and sanitization stations under municipal drinking water sanitation standards.
